description: This file contains a Smarty plugin for rendering HTML radio button groups via the {html_radios} function. It defines the main function `smarty_function_html_radios` and a helper `smarty_function_html_radios_output`, handling parameters, escaping, and output formatting for radio inputs.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios
methods.description: Main function that generates a list of HTML radio inputs based on provided parameters, supporting options like labels, separators, and assignments.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios_output
methods.description: Helper function that creates individual radio input HTML snippets with labeling, escaping, and checked attribute logic.
